Elapsed 00:00 Remaining time unknown − --:-- 0.25 × 0.5 × 0.75 × 1 × 1.25 × 1.5 × 1.75 × 2 × A new species of product tool Software development is at an inflection point. Artificial intelligence is fundamentally reshaping how products are built. AI increases what teams can create, but it also raises the bar for clarity and coordination. At Linear, we are building the tools for this new era of product development. A purpose-built system where teams and agents operate together in a shared, structured environment. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the tool of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. Meet the team behind Linear We are designers and engineers. Problem solvers and storytellers. We are a diverse team of individuals, all makers at heart. Open roles ↓ Elapsed 00:00 Remaining time unknown − --:-- 0.25 × 0.5 × 0.75 × 1 × 1.25 × 1.5 × 1.75 × 2 × On a quest for quality We believe that there is a lost art of building software. A craftsmanship that yields products of an exceptional, almost magical, quality. It’s difficult to describe this quality with words and impossible to measure it in numbers, but you can feel it when it’s there. You know it when you experience it. To bring back this level of quality, we are building a tool that empowers product teams to do their best work. A tool with unparalleled speed, focus, and design. Building this tool requires a team of talented individuals who care deeply about the quality of their work, no matter if it’s engineering, design, or customer support. We are looking for people who share our passion for software craftsmanship and getting even the smallest details right. If that sounds like you, please reach out and join us on our quest. ›_ README A conversation on quality Karri Saarinen → Building the sync engine Tuomas Artman → Inside design at Linear Designer Fund → At home with Karri Saarinen Indie → Move fast with little process The Pragmatic Engineer → A conversation on quality Karri Saarinen Building the sync engine Tuomas Artman Inside design at Linear Designer Fund At home with Karri Saarinen Indie Move fast with little process The Pragmatic Engineer How we think and work Linear’s mission is to inspire and accelerate builders. To turn that ambition into reality, we operate based on a set of core principles that keep us focused. 01 . Ship early Simplify and ship smaller. 02 . Build with users Listen carefully and understand their problems. 03 . Know what good looks like Find and create good things. Know what needs to change to make it better. 04 . Think in principles Not in playbooks. 05 . Build things that last Put care into the foundation. Don’t make it a future person’s problem. 06 . Avoid side quests Don’t fix every problem. Avoid adding unnecessary process or documents. 07 . Say it as it is Get to the point and assume good intentions. 08 . Keep the team small, do more with less We build better with fewer people. Wear multiple hats. 09 . Hire the best people The best people hire the best people. Help recruit. 10 . Create fans Build a community of people who use, love, and defend the product. 11 . Fully remote The freedom to work remotely allows for more meaningful work.
